tools.name: list_form_fields
tools.description: Use this when the user attaches a fillable PDF form and wants to see its fields or wants it filled. It returns each AcroForm field with its full name, type (text, checkbox, radio, dropdown, listbox, signature), current value, options, required flag, maximum length, page and the printed label next to

tools.name: fill_pdf_form
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to fill in a fillable PDF form with given answers. Pass the attached PDF and a list of {field, value} using the field names from list_form_fields: text for text fields, true/false for checkboxes, one listed option for radio groups and dropdowns (case-insensitive matches
